correctness.rationale: Residue arithmetic supplies a complete face enumeration (17,68,68) with zero 3-simplices. The supplied 16-edge spanning tree and 52 successive exactly-one-unknown-edge triangle relators prove fundamental-group triviality and exhibit a unimodular 52x52 boundary minor, giving integral \(H_1=0\) and \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^{16}\). Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead give the wedge homotopy type. Signed Lefschetz computations across 136 affine maps give the 16,-1,0 character, equal to the rational vertex-augmentation character. The embedded reproducible finite checker tests all these finite assertions.

value.rationale: The unique Ramsey (4,4)-extremal 17-vertex Paley graph is a canonical highly symmetric strongly regular example. The theorem gives its precise integral homotopy type, plus complete rational second-homology symmetry module across 136 automorphisms; these provide non-Betti equivariant data and an exact benchmark for topology of small conference-graph flag complexes.
